description: Scissor jump switching lunge feet mid-air — taekwondo and capoeira leg-speed staple.
instructions: From a split-stance, jump and switch feet mid-air. Land softly. 20 total jumps (10 per lead leg).
progression: Jumping switch lunge with light dumbbells.

name: Paper-Cut Test Drill (Iaido Edge Alignment)
description: Slow-motion cutting drill against a suspended paper strip — edge-alignment skill.
instructions: Hang a paper strip at shoulder height. With bokken or dowel, practice slow-motion cuts that clip the paper without tearing it. 10-15 cuts.
progression: Faster cutting speed or blind-folded draws.

name: Trapeze Plank Hold
description: Plank with feet elevated and straight-arm grip — catamaran/skiff trapeze-style iso.
instructions: Plank with feet on a low bench, arms straight, hands on the floor, body in line. Hold 30-45s.
progression: Feet higher or add arm reach.

name: Neck Extensor Endurance (Prone Hold)
description: Prone neck-extensor endurance hold — hang-gliding and racing-sail postural prehab.
instructions: Prone on a mat, hands under chin. Lift head so the cervical spine is neutral. Hold 30-60s without jutting the chin. 3 sets.
progression: Add light weight plate on back of head.

name: Forward-Leaning Run-Launch Drill
description: Dryland forward-leaning run drill simulating a paraglide launch.
instructions: Hold a light pole or yoke with arms outstretched overhead simulating risers. Lean forward aggressively and run 10-20 m as if taking off. Reset. 5-8 launches.

name: Reverse-Launch Wing Handling Drill
description: Reverse-facing handling pattern simulating a kiting paraglide wing.
instructions: Face backward holding risers (or two handles on a band anchored to a wall). Lean back, pull risers, turn, step forward, and sprint. 5-8 reps.
home_variation: Bands or paraglide wing + open space.

name: Shoulder-Blade Endurance (Y-T-W on Bench)
description: Prone Y-T-W mid-back endurance — classic sailing and gliding prehab.
instructions: Prone on a bench with light dumbbells. Perform 8 Ys (arms at 120 deg), 8 Ts (90 deg), 8 Ws (elbows at sides). Thumbs up.
progression: Heavier DB or paused at top.

name: Balance-Board Swivel Squat
description: Squat on balance board — vestibular and ankle training for land-sailing, sailing, gliding.
instructions: Stand on a balance board. Squat to a shallow depth while stabilizing. 6-8 reps. Work up to deeper squats.

name: Adductor Ball Squeeze (Rider Seat)
description: Seated adductor squeeze with a ball — seat and inner-thigh strength for riders.
instructions: Sit upright on a chair with a small ball between the knees. Squeeze hard for 5s, relax 2s. 10 reps.
progression: Longer hold or add KB goblet.

name: Rider Core Plank with Reach
description: Plank with alternating arm reach — core stability for rein handling under motion.
instructions: From a push-up plank, slowly reach one arm forward, return, switch. 8 per side. Keep hips square and level.
progression: Longer holds each reach or deficit plank.

name: Sparring-Ready Rider Mobility Flow
description: Short full-body mobility flow before riding — hips, thoracic, ankle.
instructions: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 thoracic rotations per side, 5 ankle circles per side, 5 cat-cow. 3 rounds.

name: Casting Practice Drill (Fly Fishing)
description: Deliberate fly-casting drill in dryland with a rod or dowel — tempo and shoulder coordination.
instructions: With a fly rod (no line) or dowel, perform 30-50 casts focusing on 10-2 o'clock stroke, stopping crisply. Alternate arms.

name: Shoulder External Rotation Band
description: Banded external rotation — bow and shotgun shooter rotator-cuff endurance.
instructions: Anchor a band at elbow height. Grip with the far hand, elbow tucked at 90. Rotate the forearm outward. 12-15 reps per side.

name: Stillness + Aim Drill
description: Static aim-hold over a target — breath + postural control for archery and clay shooting.
instructions: Hold the bow (or a shotgun) in full-aim position over a dry target. Hold for 10-15s without shake. 6-8 reps with rest.
progression: Longer holds or add heart-rate variability monitoring.

name: T-Spine Rotation with Reach
description: Side-lying thoracic rotation with arm reach — bread-and-butter for golfers' thoracic mobility.
instructions: Side-lying, knees at 90. Open the top arm across the body, following with eyes. Hold 3s. Return. 8 per side.
progression: Add a yoga block / slow return phase.

name: Single-Arm Kettlebell Swing (Golf Power)
description: Unilateral KB swing — asymmetric hinge power for golf and golf-fitness.
instructions: Hike a KB one-handed between legs, snap the hips to drive it chest-high. Catch in the same hand. 10 per side.
progression: Heavier KB or switch-hand swings mid-set.

name: Mini-Band Lateral Shuffle (Disc Golf)
description: Mini-band lateral shuffle — hip abductor activation for disc-golf/topgolf reach & rotate.
instructions: Mini-band above the knees. Assume half-squat. Shuffle laterally 10 steps, return. Repeat 3-5 rounds.

name: Senior-Friendly Golf Mobility Warmup
description: Short mobility warm-up for 55+ golfers — hip, thoracic, shoulder prep with no load.
instructions: Cycle: 5 hip circles per side, 5 arm circles forward / back, 5 torso rotations, 5 bodyweight squats. 2 rounds.

name: Half-Kneeling Cable Chop (Golf)
description: Cable chop from half-kneeling — trains rotational power without locking the hips.
instructions: Half-kneel sideways to a cable stack. Pull a high-attachment handle down and across with both hands to the far hip. 8-10 per side.
progression: Heavier cable or add standing rotation.

name: Topgolf Swing Tempo Drill
description: Slow-motion swing-tempo drill — for topgolf/range practice players without breaking form.
instructions: Take a normal golf stance. Perform slow-motion swings (3 sec backswing, 3 sec downswing). 10 slow swings, 5 normal. Repeat.

name: Deep Forward Lunge Rotation
description: Deep lunge with torso rotation — common for bow hunting stalks and golf end-of-swing follow-through.
instructions: Step into a deep forward lunge, then rotate the torso over the front knee. Hold 2-3s. Alternate. 6-8 per side.
progression: Add a med-ball reach to deepen rotation.

name: Static Balance with Rifle/Bow Mount
description: Static single-leg balance while holding a rifle/bow mount — real-hunt prep.
instructions: Stand on one leg in a soft shoe. Mount a rifle or bow (or PVC). Hold 30-45s. Switch.

name: Clay-Pigeon Follow-Through Drill
description: Slow-motion horizontal tracking drill — trap/skeet/sporting-clays follow-through.
instructions: Mount an unloaded shotgun (or dowel). Track a horizontal line across the wall smoothly, pulling the trigger-finger midway, follow-through to the far side. 5 per side.

name: Low-Row Isometric (Archery Posture)
description: Rowed isometric with light band — prehab for archery / bow hunting upper-back endurance.
instructions: Anchor band at chest height. Grip and row elbows past the ribs. Hold 20-30s. Keep mid-back squeezed.
progression: Longer hold or unilateral row iso.

name: Walk-and-Aim Drill
description: Walk forward while maintaining steady aim — rifle/shotgun/bow simulation in motion.
instructions: Walk slowly and steadily while holding an aim line on a far target. 15-30 m sets. Quiet footfalls, steady breath.

name: Sun Salutation Flow (Yoga Warmup)
description: Surya Namaskar chain — warm-up and mobility flow core to any yoga practice.
instructions: Cycle: mountain pose, forward fold, half-lift, low push-up, upward dog, downward dog, step forward, fold, return. 5-8 full rounds.

name: Swing Rock-Step Drill
description: Foundational swing-dance rock-step pattern — rhythmic footwork drill.
instructions: Stand. Rock step back onto the right foot, shift weight back to left, tap-step tap-step in the rhythm of swing timing. 2-3 min continuous.

name: Skate Edge Lateral Pushes
description: Dryland lateral push drill — skating-wheeled and roller-derby specific stride.
instructions: In skate stance, push off one booty to slide laterally onto the other foot. Alternate. 30-60s sets. Work on full weight transfer.
home_variation: Socks on smooth floor or slide board.
progression: Slide board or load for harder push.

name: Slackline Static Single-Leg
description: Single-leg balance hold on a slackline — highline/slackline balance skill.
instructions: Stand on a low slackline with one foot. Hold 15-30 sec. Use eyes on a fixed point. Switch sides.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — Steffen A. Frost (CC BY-SA 4.0)

name: Olympic Snatch-Balance (Empty Bar)
description: Snatch-balance drill with empty bar — Olympic-weightlifting technique progression.
instructions: Grip bar wide overhead behind neck. Press bar up as you drop into an overhead squat. Drive back to standing. 5-6 reps.

name: Kettlebell Snatch Sets
description: High-rep kettlebell snatch sets — kettlebell-sport specific endurance.
instructions: Snatch a moderate KB (16-24 kg) 10-15 reps per side, alternating each set. 5-10 sets total. Rest as needed.
progression: Heavier KB or EMOM snatch sets.

name: Sandbag Stone-to-Shoulder
description: Sandbag / stone lifted from floor to shoulder — strongman / highland games specific.
instructions: Lift a heavy sandbag from the floor. Drag to chest, transition to one shoulder. Walk 5-10m. Drop. 4-6 reps alternating shoulders.

name: Pilates Hundred (Classic)
description: Pilates Hundred — classic core endurance exercise.
instructions: Lie supine, head and shoulders lifted, legs at 45 deg, arms hovering. Pump arms small and fast, breathing 5-in/5-out. 100 pumps total.

name: Bodybuilder Lateral Raise (Myo-Reps)
description: Dumbbell lateral raise with myo-reps — bodybuilding shoulder size-building protocol.
instructions: Lateral raise 15-20 reps, rest 15 sec. Repeat 3-5 mini-sets of 5-8 reps with same rest. Strict form.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — No machine-readable author provided. GeorgeStepanek assumed (based on copyright claims). (CC BY-SA 3.0)

name: Highland Games Caber Sim (Sandbag Flip)
description: Long sandbag lift and flip — simulates the caber toss of highland games.
instructions: Stand a long sandbag upright. Hoist it onto the shoulder, then with a run-up, release the bag forward into a vertical flip. 3-5 reps.
cues: release at the top of the arc

name: Slack-Line Walk Across
description: Full walk across a slackline — slacklining skill progression.
instructions: On a short low slackline, walk from one anchor to the other. Start with a spotter. 3-5 full crossings.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — Steffen A. Frost (CC BY-SA 4.0)

name: Hydrofoil Pump-Balance Drill
description: Balance + micro-squat drill simulating hydrofoil pumping cadence.
instructions: Stand on a balance board. Small continuous knee-bend pumps (5-10 deg) without losing balance. 30-60 sec.

name: Beach-Tennis Lateral Lunge Drill
description: Low lateral lunges + racquet swings — beach-tennis and paddle footwork.
instructions: Step into a deep lateral lunge, swing racquet across. Reset, other side. 10 per side.
progression: Faster tempo or with partner feeds.

name: BMX Standing Start Sprint Drill
description: Explosive standing-start sprint specific to BMX gate starts and track launches.
instructions: From a split-stance standing position, explode into 10-15 m sprint as if clearing a BMX gate. Walk back, full recovery. 4-6 reps.
progression: Weighted sled start or paired with plyo bounds.

name: Cyclocross Dismount-Remount Drill
description: Repeated cyclocross-style running dismount and remount on flat ground — specific to the CX course skill set.
instructions: Ride slowly, unclip, swing leg over and land running, carry bike 10-15 m, remount on the fly. 6-10 reps.
progression: Add a shouldered bike carry over a small barrier.

name: Indoor-Cycling Standing Climb Interval
description: Standing out-of-saddle climb interval on an indoor trainer — replicates Zwift/Peloton-style climb work.
instructions: On a trainer with moderate resistance (70-80% FTP), ride out of the saddle at 60-70 rpm for 60-90 sec, seated recovery 90 sec. Repeat 4-6x.

name: Fell-Running Steep Ascent Hike-Run
description: Alternating hike and run on steep gradient — fell-running and mountain-run specific.
instructions: On a 15-25% gradient, alternate 60s power-hike with 60s run-jog, for 10-20 min. Use poles if available.

name: Sprinting-Masters A-Skip
description: Low-intensity A-skip warm-up drill appropriate for masters sprinters — grooves the sprint pattern without max load.
instructions: Skip for 20 m with aggressive knee drive (knee to 90), foot dorsiflexed, tall posture. Walk back. 4-6 reps.
progression: Add B-skip and transition to accel.

name: Aid-Climbing Top-Step Balance Iso
description: High-foot single-leg balance hold with one hand grip — direct aid-climbing top-step transfer.
instructions: Place one foot on a knee-height box. Rise fully, gripping a light overhead handle with one hand. Hold stacked tall for 15-30s per side.

name: Alpine Kick-Step Traverse Sim
description: Side-step with weight shift on steep ground — replicates alpine kick-step traverse on snow/ice.
instructions: Find a 30-45 degree slope (or box at that angle). Take small kick-steps across the slope, engaging edge of foot. 10-15 steps per direction.
home_variation: Grassy slope or dense foam wedge.

name: Scrambling Three-Point Step-Down Drill
description: Slow, deliberate step-downs on rough terrain maintaining three points of contact — scrambling-specific skill.
instructions: On a short rocky step 1-2 ft high, face in, place hands, step down one foot at a time keeping two hands + one foot contact. 10-15 reps.

name: Freestyle-Ski Landing Squat-Jump
description: Jump landing absorption drill — bread and butter for freestyle/park skiing and boardsports.
instructions: Jump off a box (12-18 in), land soft into a quarter squat and absorb, holding 1-2 sec. Step up and repeat. 5-8 reps.

name: Ski-Jumping In-Run Tuck Isometric
description: Deep tuck isometric hold — ski jumping and downhill in-run position.
instructions: Assume a deep-squat tuck with elbows outside the knees, chest over thighs, arms relaxed. Hold 20-45s. 3-4 sets.

name: Karate Kata Flow Drill
description: Slow-tempo kata-like movement chain — blends mobility and kinetic-chain coordination.
instructions: Chain 6-8 karate stances (zenkutsu, kokutsu, kiba-dachi) with transitions and blocks at slow tempo. 3-5 min continuous.

name: Krav-Maga 360-Defense Drill
description: Rapid arm-block drill against 360-degree attacks — central Krav Maga reactive pattern.
instructions: Partner or pad-holder simulates attacks from different angles (or set cones at 8 directions). Step off-line and block-strike to each direction. 30-60s rounds.

name: Sambo Belt-Grip Takedown Entry
description: Repeated belt-grip entry step — sambo-specific takedown setup drill.
instructions: Face partner or heavy bag. Step in with aggressive belt/hip grip, drop levels, drive forward 2-3 steps. Reset and repeat. 6-8 entries per side.
progression: Add takedown finish or weighted entry.

name: Aikido Tenkan Pivot Flow
description: Continuous pivot-turn flow — foundational aikido ukemi and blending footwork.
instructions: Stand in natural stance. Pivot 180 deg on the lead foot, step through, pivot again. Continuous smooth rotations for 2-3 min.
progression: Add partner redirect or pace variation.

name: Kung-Fu Horse-Stance Conditioning
description: Classic deep horse-stance hold — foundational kung fu lower-body conditioning.
instructions: Stand wide, thighs parallel to ground, back straight, hands at chamber. Hold 30-90s. 3-4 sets.

name: Capoeira Ginga Flow
description: Rhythmic ginga step — foundational capoeira rhythm-and-movement pattern.
instructions: Alternate back-step and side-step with arms rising in counter-rhythm. 2-3 min continuous at musical tempo.

name: Kendo Men-Strike Footwork Drill
description: Suri-ashi slide-step with overhead shinai strike — kendo-specific.
instructions: From shizen-tai, slide-step forward right foot, strike overhead with shinai, recover. 8-12 per side.

name: Topgolf Club-Speed Swing Drill
description: Light-club overspeed swing — pure rotational speed training for casual golfers and Topgolf.
instructions: Use a 5-iron or lighter club. 10 swings per side at 90-95% effort, focused on smooth tempo. 2-3 sets.

name: Disc-Golf Pivot-Throw Rotation
description: Standing pivot-throw rotation with a light band — replicates backhand disc throw.
instructions: Band anchored at chest height. Stand side-on. Drive band across body in a smooth pivot, hip-first. 10-12 per side.

name: Raft Guide Sweep Stroke
description: Wide bilateral rotational paddle sweep — raft guiding and whitewater position.
instructions: Hold a dowel or paddle. From kneeling, sweep the paddle in a wide arc around the body from front to rear, 10-12 per side.
progression: Weighted paddle or add resistance band.
source_video_attribution: Kayak Sweep Strokes - How to Paddle (YouTube)
image_attribution: Kayak Sweep Strokes - How to Paddle (YouTube)

name: Kitesurf Edge-Set Drop Squat
description: Quick drop into eccentric half-squat — kitesurf edge-set and board-control absorption.
instructions: From tall stance, drop into a quarter squat absorbing in 1-2 sec, then rise. 10-12 reps.

name: Skimboard Slide-Land Step
description: Running approach and slide-step landing — skimboarding-specific.
instructions: From a 3-5 step run-up, plant one foot and glide into a narrow-stance squat, mimicking dropping onto a skimboard. 8-10 per lead side.

name: Hydrofoil Pump Balance-Board Drill
description: Balance-board pump drill — hydrofoiling-specific bob/pump motion.
instructions: Stand on a balance board. Rhythmic hip pump loading front-back with small knee bend. 30-60s sets.

name: Dodgeball Catch-and-Throw Reaction
description: Reactive catch-and-throw drill with a med-ball — dodgeball/kickball transition.
instructions: Partner tosses a 4-6 lb med-ball at unpredictable heights. Catch and return with rotational throw. 30-45s rounds.

name: Ultimate Frisbee Layout Core-Plank
description: Extended plank with reach — prepares the layout (dive-catch) position core demand.
instructions: From plank, reach one arm forward to full extension, hold 3-5 sec, return. Alternate arms. 8-10 per side.
progression: Add sliders or weight on back.

name: Pilates Roll-Up Control
description: Slow controlled roll-up from supine — classic pilates core control.
instructions: Supine, arms overhead. Slowly roll up one vertebra at a time to seated, reach for toes, roll back down with control. 6-10 reps.

name: Tai-Chi Single Whip Pose Flow
description: Single-whip pose transition — tai chi flowing balance and mobility.
instructions: Step out into a wide stance with one arm extended, opposite fingertips pinched. Hold 10-20s per side. 3-4 transitions.
progression: Chain with cloud hands or qigong sequence.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — Unknown authorUnknown author (Public domain)

name: Mountain-Board Carve Shift Drill
description: Lateral weight-shift carving drill on a balance board — mountain-boarding/downhill specific.
instructions: Stand on a balance board, riding stance. Shift weight heel-to-toe in a smooth carve rhythm for 30-45s.
progression: Higher fulcrum or add dynamic pump.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — DLangrish (English Wikipedia User Name) (CC BY-SA 3.0)

name: Slackline Dynamic Turn Drill
description: Turnaround walking on a slackline — builds dynamic balance beyond static holds.
instructions: Walk 2-3 steps on a low slackline, pause, rotate 180 deg, walk back. 4-6 turnarounds.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — Steffen A. Frost (CC BY-SA 4.0)

name: Swing-Dance Triple-Step Drill
description: Rhythmic triple-step pattern at musical tempo — swing-dance and lindy hop specific.
instructions: Triple-step (step-step-step) right, triple-step left in swing rhythm. 2-3 min continuous with breaks.
progression: Add partner hold or fuller footwork.

name: Powerlifting Paused-Squat Pause
description: Back squat with 2-sec bottom pause — builds powerlifting-specific out-of-hole strength.
instructions: Back squat to depth, pause 2 sec in the hole, drive up. 4-6 reps per set at 60-75% 1RM.

name: Indoor-Cycling Seated Threshold Interval
description: Seated threshold interval on an indoor trainer — structured session for Zwift/Peloton users.
instructions: On a trainer, ride at 88-92% FTP for 6-10 min, 3-5 min recovery between. 3-4 intervals.

name: Fell-Running Technical Descent Run
description: Short fast downhill with technical footing — fell-running and mountain-run descent specific.
instructions: On a rough trail or grass slope 5-15% down, run 100-200 m at confident fast-downhill pace. Walk back. 3-5 reps.

name: Masters-Sprint Flying 20
description: Flying 20-meter sprint with rolling start — age-friendly sprint work without max-accel risk.
instructions: Build to near-max speed over 20-30 m, then maintain through a 20 m flying zone. Walk back. 4-6 reps.
progression: Add short hill flys or resistance.

name: Karate Front-Kick Hold
description: Extended-position front-kick isometric — karate kick-chamber and hip-flexor strength.
instructions: Stand tall. Chamber one knee to chest, extend the kick and hold 5-10 sec. 4-6 per side.

name: Kung-Fu Crane Balance
description: One-leg crane stance hold — foundational kung-fu balance pose.
instructions: Stand on one leg, opposite knee lifted, opposite arm raised in crane beak. Hold 20-45s per side.

name: HEMA Grapple-Throw Entry
description: Step-and-grip entry drill — HEMA ringen and sword-grapple specific.
instructions: From fighting stance, step with lead foot to partner/bag level, grip, rotate hips to throw entry. 6-8 per side.

name: KB Sport Long-Cycle Breath Drill
description: Kettlebell Sport specific clean+jerk with breath rhythm — teaches the pacing pattern.
instructions: With a light kettlebell (8-12 kg), perform clean+jerk every 6-8 sec maintaining a relaxed breath cycle. 1-2 min continuous.
cues: breath at rack and at top

name: Archery Draw-Hold Isometric
description: Band-draw-and-hold isometric — archery-specific draw endurance.
instructions: Band anchored at chest height in front. Draw to full archer position (anchor at jaw), hold 10-20s. 4-6 reps.

name: Shotgun Mount Rotation Drill
description: Shoulder-mount with pivot — trap/skeet/sporting-clays swing motion.
instructions: Hold a lightweight dowel (shotgun sim). Mount to shoulder while pivoting feet through the swing direction. 10-12 per side.

name: Dressage Seated Balance Iso
description: Seated balance-ball hold in dressage posture — rider seat stability.
instructions: Sit on a stability ball in dressage posture (shoulders-hip-heel aligned, tall spine). Hold 60-120s without feet touching.

name: Polo Mallet Swing Rotation
description: Rotational swing with dowel simulating polo mallet — polo-specific shoulder and core rotation.
instructions: Hold dowel one-handed at chest. Rotate into forehand swing, finish high. 10-12 per side.

name: Calisthenics Skill Scale-Pose
description: Side-scale balance pose — calisthenics/movement-culture skill.
instructions: Stand on one leg. Raise the other leg out to the side to 90 degrees, arms balanced. Hold 10-20s per side.
regression: Hand on wall, lower leg height.
progression: Longer hold or add weighted foot.

name: Bodybuilding Paused-Curl
description: Dumbbell curl with 2-sec pause at peak — bodybuilding-specific hypertrophy tool.
instructions: Perform a standing dumbbell curl. At the top (bicep peak), pause 2 sec. 8-12 per side or bilaterally.

name: Oly Split-Jerk Position Drill
description: Split-position overhead hold — Olympic weightlifting split-jerk receiving.
instructions: With an empty bar overhead, step into a split position (lead leg ~90, rear heel raised). Hold 5-10 sec. 4-6 per side.

name: Judo/BJJ Bridge-Hip-Escape Flow
description: Chained bridge + hip-escape drill — grappling ground-movement specific.
instructions: Supine. Bridge (hips up), then shrimp to the side (hip escape). Alternate sides. 8-12 reps.

name: Barbell Bench Press
description: Flat barbell bench press — primary horizontal-push strength lift.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with eyes under the bar. Grip slightly wider than shoulder width. Unrack, brace, lower the bar to mid-chest with control, then press to lockout. Keep feet planted and shoulder blades retracted.
progression: Pause bench press or weight increase.

name: Incline Barbell Bench Press
description: Incline (30-45°) barbell bench press — upper-chest and front-delt bias.
instructions: Set bench to 30-45°. Grip slightly wider than shoulders, unrack, lower to upper chest, press to lockout. Keep ribs over hips, do not flare the elbows.

name: Close-Grip Bench Press
description: Narrow-grip barbell bench press — triceps and lockout bias for press strength carry-over.
instructions: Grip shoulder-width or slightly narrower. Tuck elbows close to the body, lower bar to lower chest, press to lockout. Avoid wrist-width grip — keep wrists stacked.
progression: Pin press or floor press at heavier load.

name: Floor Press (Barbell)
description: Barbell bench press from the floor — partial ROM with hard pause for lockout strength.
instructions: Lie on the floor under a barbell in a rack or with spotters. Lower the bar until the upper arms touch the floor, pause briefly, then press. Eliminates leg drive.

name: Barbell Overhead Press (Strict)
description: Standing strict barbell press — vertical-push foundation, no leg drive.
instructions: Set bar at front rack, hip-width stance. Brace hard, press the bar straight overhead, pushing head through at lockout. Lower under control. No knee bend.

name: Push Press
description: Overhead barbell press with a leg-drive dip — moves heavier load than strict press.
instructions: Front-rack the bar. Small fast dip at the knees (10-15°), then drive vertically through the legs to launch the bar overhead. Finish with arms straight and feet planted.

name: Push Jerk
description: Push press with a re-bend under the bar — receives load with bent knees, drives up to lockout.
instructions: Dip and drive as in a push press. As the bar leaves the shoulders, drop fast into a partial squat with arms locked overhead, then stand to finish.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — Diplomatic Security Service (Public domain)

name: Incline Dumbbell Bench Press
description: Incline dumbbell press — upper chest with independent arm path.
instructions: Set bench to 30-45°. Press dumbbells from shoulder level to lockout, palms facing forward or slightly inward. Lower with control.
cues: do not clang dumbbells at top

name: Seated Dumbbell Press
description: Seated dumbbell overhead press — vertical push with independent arms.
instructions: Sit on a bench with back support (or upright). Press dumbbells from shoulder level overhead. Lower under control, dumbbells stop near the ears.
progression: Standing dumbbell press or heavier load.

name: Arnold Press
description: Rotational dumbbell overhead press — sweeps through full shoulder ROM.
instructions: Sit holding dumbbells in front of shoulders, palms facing you. Press up while rotating palms to face forward at lockout. Reverse on the descent.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons, CC BY-SA 3.0, author: Everkinetic

name: Hang Clean
description: Power clean from the hang — bar starts at mid-thigh, no floor pull.
instructions: Stand with bar at mid-thigh. Hinge slightly, then explode by extending hips, knees, ankles. Shrug, pull under, and catch the bar on the shoulders in a partial squat.
regression: Hang muscle clean or hang high pull.

name: Clean Pull
description: Clean lift through the second pull, no catch — top-end pulling strength.
instructions: Set up as for a clean. Pull from the floor, extend explosively at the hips and shrug hard, but do not pull under the bar. Land flat-footed with shoulders shrugged.
progression: Power clean or heavier clean pull.

name: Power Snatch
description: Snatch caught above parallel — wide-grip overhead lift from the floor.
instructions: Set up over the bar with wide snatch grip. Pull off the floor smoothly, explode at the hips, then pull under and catch the bar locked out overhead in a partial squat. Stand.
regression: Snatch high pull or hang snatch.

name: Snatch Pull
description: Snatch lift through the second pull, no catch — overhead-pull strength builder.
instructions: Set up with snatch-width grip. Pull from the floor, extend explosively at the hips and shrug hard, no catch. Land flat-footed.

name: Clean & Jerk
description: Full clean from the floor followed by a jerk overhead — total-body Olympic lift.
instructions: Clean the bar from the floor to the front rack. Recover. Dip and drive the bar overhead in a push jerk or split jerk. Stand to finish with bar locked out.

name: Snatch
description: Full snatch — bar from floor to overhead in one move, catch in deep squat.
instructions: Set up over the bar with wide snatch grip. Pull, extend, and pull under aggressively, catching the bar overhead in a full overhead squat. Stand to finish.

name: Sumo Deadlift
description: Wide-stance deadlift — shorter pull range, hip- and adductor-driven.
instructions: Stance wide, toes turned out 30-45°, grip the bar inside the legs. Drop hips, chest up, pull the bar straight up by pushing the floor away. Stand and lock out.

name: Stiff-Leg Deadlift
description: Deadlift with minimal knee bend and lower-back rounding — heavy hamstring/erector emphasis.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar in front. Keep knees nearly straight. Hinge at hips, lower bar past shins, then drive hips forward to stand. Maintain neutral spine.

name: Deficit Deadlift
description: Conventional deadlift performed from a 1-3" platform — extra range, off-the-floor strength.
instructions: Stand on a low platform with the bar at normal height. Set up as for conventional deadlift but with knees more bent. Pull from the deeper position.

name: Pause Squat
description: Back squat with a 2-3 second pause in the hole — kills the stretch reflex, builds bottom-end strength.
instructions: Set up as for back squat. Descend to depth, pause 2-3 seconds without losing tightness, then drive up.

name: Box Squat
description: Back squat to a box at parallel or below — teaches depth, breaks eccentric/concentric.
instructions: Set a box at the desired depth behind you. Descend under control, sit fully on the box without losing tightness, then drive up.

name: Barbell Good Morning
description: Hip hinge with bar on the back — heavy hamstring and erector emphasis.
instructions: Bar on upper back as in a high-bar squat. Slight knee bend. Hinge at hips, lowering torso until parallel or until hamstrings limit. Stand by driving hips forward.

name: Pull-Up
description: Bodyweight pull-up, overhand grip — vertical pulling foundation.
instructions: Hang from bar with overhand grip slightly wider than shoulders. Pull until chin clears the bar. Lower with control to a dead hang.

name: Chin-Up
description: Bodyweight chin-up, supinated grip — biceps-biased vertical pull.
instructions: Hang from bar with underhand (palms-facing-you) grip shoulder-width. Pull until chin clears the bar. Lower with control.

name: Neutral-Grip Pull-Up
description: Pull-up with palms facing each other — shoulder-friendly vertical pull.
instructions: Use a parallel-grip handle or rings. Hang neutral, pull until chin clears the bar, lower under control.

name: Lat Pulldown (Wide-Grip)
description: Wide-grip lat pulldown — vertical pull for those still working up to bodyweight pull-ups, or for high-volume back work.
instructions: Sit at the lat pulldown machine, thighs anchored. Grip bar wide overhand. Pull bar to upper chest, leading with the elbows. Control the return.

name: T-Bar Row
description: Landmine or T-bar handle row — bilateral horizontal pull with mixed-grip handle.
instructions: Straddle the bar with V-handle attached at the loaded end. Hinge to ~45°, brace, row the handle to the lower chest.

name: Pendlay Row
description: Strict barbell row from the floor each rep — explosive concentric, dead-stop reset.
instructions: Hinge to torso parallel to floor. Bar starts on the floor each rep. Row explosively to the lower sternum, then return the bar fully to the floor.

name: Meadows Row
description: Single-arm landmine row using an overhand grip and staggered stance — heavy unilateral back work.
instructions: Stand to the side of a landmine bar in a staggered stance. Hinge over, grip the end of the bar overhand, row the bar to the hip. Switch sides.

name: Machine Chest-Supported Row
description: Plate-loaded or selectorized chest-supported row — fixed path, strict back work.
instructions: Sit at the row machine with chest pad supporting torso. Pull handles to the ribs, squeeze, control the return.

name: Leg Press
description: Plate-loaded or selectorized leg press — heavy quad/glute work with supported torso.
instructions: Sit in the leg press machine, feet shoulder-width on the platform. Lower the platform until knees track around 90°. Press through full foot to lockout (do not snap knees).

name: Hack Squat (Machine)
description: Sled-style hack squat — supported squat pattern with heavy quad emphasis.
instructions: Position shoulders under pads, feet shoulder-width on platform. Descend until thighs are parallel, drive up through full foot to lockout.

name: Leg Extension
description: Seated machine knee extension — isolated quad work, especially the rectus femoris and VMO.
instructions: Sit in the machine, ankles behind the pad. Extend knees fully against resistance, squeeze at the top, lower with control.
progression: Heavier load or pause at top.

name: Lying Leg Curl
description: Prone machine hamstring curl — isolated knee-flexion hamstring work.
instructions: Lie face-down on the machine, ankles under the pad. Curl heels toward glutes, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Seated Leg Curl
description: Seated machine hamstring curl — hip-flexed knee flexion, distal hamstring bias.
instructions: Sit in machine with thigh pad locking legs in place. Curl heels under, squeeze, return with control.

name: Hip Abduction (Machine)
description: Seated machine hip abduction — glute medius and minimus work.
instructions: Sit in the machine, pads outside thighs. Press knees apart against resistance, squeeze glutes, return with control.

name: Hip Adduction (Machine)
description: Seated machine hip adduction — adductor strengthening.
instructions: Sit in the machine, pads inside thighs. Squeeze knees together against resistance, return with control.

name: Cable Pull-Through
description: Hip-hinge with cable between the legs — glute and hamstring isolation with low spinal load.
instructions: Face away from cable column with rope between legs. Hinge at the hips, hands tracking down between the knees. Stand by driving the hips forward, squeezing glutes at lockout.
progression: Heavier cable load or barbell RDL.

name: 45° Back Extension
description: 45-degree hyperextension — glute, hamstring, erector strength with low spinal compression.
instructions: Set up in a 45° hyper bench with hips on the pad. Hinge at the hips, lowering torso, then extend back to neutral by squeezing glutes. Do not hyperextend lumbar.
cues: do not lock out into hyperextension
progression: Add weight plate held to chest.

name: Reverse Hyperextension
description: Reverse hyperextension machine — glute, hamstring, erector work with traction-style spinal decompression.
instructions: Lie face-down on the reverse hyper, hips at the edge. Swing legs from hang to horizontal by squeezing glutes. Control the descent.

name: Glute-Ham Raise (GHR)
description: GHD glute-ham raise — knee-flexion hamstring lift with hip-extension assist.
instructions: Set up on a glute-ham developer, knees just behind pad. Start with torso vertical, lower under control until horizontal, then curl back up by contracting hamstrings.
cues: do not collapse at the bottom

name: Seated Calf Raise
description: Seated machine calf raise — soleus-biased isolation.
instructions: Sit in the machine, knees under pads, balls of feet on the platform. Press up onto the toes, squeeze, lower under stretch.

name: Walking Lunge
description: Loaded walking lunge — alternating-leg quad/glute work that progresses distance.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides (or bar on back). Step forward into a lunge, knee tracking over toes, then push off the back leg and step forward into the next lunge.

name: Reverse Lunge (Barbell)
description: Barbell reverse lunge — knee-friendly unilateral squat pattern.
instructions: Bar on back. Step one foot back into a lunge, dropping the back knee toward the floor. Drive through the front foot to return.

name: Forward Lunge (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell forward lunge — classic alternating-leg loaded lunge.
instructions: Hold dumbbells at the sides. Step forward into a lunge, drop the back knee under control, then push back to the start.

name: Barbell Curl
description: Standing barbell curl — primary bilateral biceps lift.
instructions: Stand with feet hip-width, bar at thighs in supinated grip. Curl the bar to the shoulders by flexing the elbows. Lower with control.

name: EZ-Bar Curl
description: Curl with EZ (cambered) bar — wrist-friendly biceps lift.
instructions: Stand with EZ bar at thighs, grip the angled portion. Curl to shoulders, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Curl
description: Standing dumbbell biceps curl — alternating or simultaneous.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells at sides, palms facing in. Curl one or both dumbbells, supinating the wrist as they pass the thigh. Lower with control.

name: Incline Dumbbell Curl
description: Curl on incline bench — bias toward long-head of biceps via shoulder extension.
instructions: Sit on incline bench (45-60°), dumbbells hanging at sides. Curl without lifting the elbows forward. Lower fully each rep.

name: Hammer Curl
description: Neutral-grip curl — brachialis and brachioradialis bias.
instructions: Hold dumbbells with palms facing each other. Curl without rotating the wrist. Lower with control.

name: Concentration Curl
description: Seated single-arm dumbbell curl with elbow braced on inner thigh — strict biceps isolation.
instructions: Sit on a bench, elbow braced on inner thigh, dumbbell hanging. Curl to shoulder, squeeze hard at the top, lower fully.

name: Cable Curl
description: Standing cable curl with bar or rope — constant tension biceps work.
instructions: Face a low cable with a bar or rope attached. Curl by flexing the elbows, keeping them at your sides. Lower under tension.

name: Tricep Pushdown
description: Cable triceps pushdown with V-bar or straight bar — primary cable triceps lift.
instructions: Stand at a high cable with a V-bar or straight bar attached. Tuck elbows at sides, push the bar down to lockout, squeeze triceps. Return with control.

name: Rope Pushdown
description: Cable rope triceps pushdown with end-range split — lateral-head triceps emphasis.
instructions: Use a rope attachment on a high cable. Push down, splitting the rope outward at the bottom. Squeeze triceps, return with control.
cues: split the rope at the bottom

name: Overhead Cable Triceps Extension
description: Cable overhead triceps extension with rope — long-head triceps emphasis in lengthened position.
instructions: Face away from a cable column with rope attached at low or mid pulley. Rope behind head, elbows pointing forward. Extend arms overhead, return with control.

name: Tricep Kickback (Dumbbell)
description: Bent-over single-arm dumbbell kickback — strict triceps isolation.
instructions: Hinge over with one hand on a bench. Pin upper arm parallel to torso. Extend the elbow until arm is straight, squeeze, return with control.
progression: Heavier dumbbell or pause at lockout.

name: Diamond Push-Up
description: Bodyweight close-stance push-up with hands forming a diamond — triceps and inner-chest bias.
instructions: In a push-up position place hands close so thumbs and index fingers touch, forming a diamond. Lower chest to the hands, press up.

name: Cable Lateral Raise
description: Single-arm cable lateral raise — constant-tension lateral-delt work.
instructions: Stand sideways to a low cable, handle in the outside hand. Raise arm out to the side to shoulder height, lower under tension.
progression: Heavier load or higher rep myo-reps.

name: Dumbbell Front Raise
description: Dumbbell front raise — anterior-delt isolation.
instructions: Stand with dumbbells in front of thighs. Raise one or both dumbbells to shoulder height with straight arms, lower under control.

name: Cable Reverse Fly
description: Standing cable reverse fly with cables crossed — rear-delt isolation with constant tension.
instructions: Stand at a dual cable station, cables crossed (right hand grabs left cable and vice versa). Pull arms out to the sides at shoulder height, squeezing rear delts.

name: Rear Delt Pec Deck
description: Reverse pec-deck machine — fixed-path rear delt isolation.
instructions: Sit facing the pec deck with handles set for reverse use. Drive elbows back, squeezing rear delts. Control the return.

name: Upright Row (Barbell)
description: Barbell upright row — traps and lateral-delt work; shoulder-position aware.
instructions: Stand with barbell at hip-width grip. Pull the bar up the body to mid-chest, elbows leading high. Lower with control. Stop short of shoulder pain.
regression: Cable or DB upright row to shoulder height.

name: Barbell Shrug
description: Standing barbell shrug — upper-trap isolation.
instructions: Hold a barbell at thigh height (or rack pin). Shrug shoulders straight up toward ears, squeeze, lower under control.
progression: Heavier load or longer hold at top.

name: Dumbbell Shrug
description: Dumbbell shrug — upper-trap isolation with neutral-grip dumbbells.
instructions: Hold heavy dumbbells at the sides. Shrug shoulders straight up, squeeze, lower with control.

name: Dumbbell Fly (Flat)
description: Flat-bench dumbbell fly — chest stretch and adduction work.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench with dumbbells over the chest, palms facing in, slight elbow bend. Lower the dumbbells out in an arc until you feel a chest stretch. Bring them back together by squeezing the chest.

name: Incline Dumbbell Fly
description: Incline dumbbell fly — upper-chest stretch and adduction.
instructions: Set bench to 30-45°. Hold dumbbells over the chest with a slight elbow bend. Lower the dumbbells out in an arc, then squeeze them back together.

name: Pec Deck Fly
description: Pec deck machine — fixed-path chest fly with controlled stretch and squeeze.
instructions: Sit at the pec-deck machine with forearms or hands on the pads. Bring the pads together by squeezing the chest. Control the return.

name: Crunch
description: Floor crunch — rectus abdominis isolation, short-range trunk flexion.
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat. Hands at temples (not pulling the neck). Curl the upper torso off the floor, exhale at the top. Lower with control.
image_attribution: Wikimedia Commons — No machine-readable author provided. GeorgeStepanek assumed (based on copyright claims). (CC BY-SA 3.0)

name: Sit-Up
description: Bodyweight sit-up — full trunk flexion with hip-flexor involvement.
instructions: Lie on back, knees bent, feet flat or anchored. Sit up by curling the spine off the floor until torso is vertical, lower under control.

name: Russian Twist
description: Seated rotational twist — oblique work with optional weight.
instructions: Sit on the floor, knees bent, lean torso back to ~45°. Hold weight at chest (or bodyweight). Rotate torso side to side, touching weight toward each hip.

name: Bicycle Crunch
description: Alternating elbow-to-knee crunch with leg cycling — combined flexion and rotation.
instructions: Lie on back, hands at temples. Bring one knee toward the chest while rotating the opposite elbow to meet it. Alternate sides in a smooth cycling motion.

name: Cable Crunch
description: Kneeling cable crunch — heavy weighted spinal flexion for the rectus abdominis.
instructions: Kneel facing a high cable with rope attachment, rope behind/over the shoulders. Curl the torso down toward the floor by flexing the spine. Return under control.
cues: do not hinge at the hips
progression: Heavier cable load or paused reps.

name: Front Plank
description: Standard prone plank — anti-extension core endurance.
instructions: Forearms on the floor, elbows under shoulders, body in a straight line. Brace through the core, glutes, and quads. Hold the position.

name: Reverse Crunch
description: Lying reverse crunch — lower-rectus emphasis via posterior pelvic tilt.
instructions: Lie on back, hands at sides or under hips. Bring knees toward chest by curling the pelvis off the floor. Lower with control.

name: Hanging Knee Raise
description: Hanging from a pull-up bar, raise knees to hip height — core and hip-flexor work.
instructions: Hang from a pull-up bar with arms straight. Raise knees toward the chest by flexing hips and lower abs. Lower under control without swinging.

name: Wrist Curl (Dumbbell)
description: Seated dumbbell wrist curl — forearm-flexor strengthening, palms-up.
instructions: Sit with forearm on thigh, palm up, dumbbell in hand. Let the wrist drop, then curl the weight up by flexing the wrist. Lower under control.
progression: Heavier dumbbell or barbell wrist curl.

name: Ab Wheel
description: Ab wheel rollout (kneeling) — anti-extension core work; the floor presses on the abs as the body extends.
instructions: Kneel, grip the wheel. Roll forward as far as you can while keeping ribs down and hips locked. Pull back to start.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Around the World
description: Around-the-world — semi-circular DB fly variation that hits clavicular pec + front delt through a continuous arc.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, DBs at hip level palms-up. Arc DBs out and overhead in a wide semicircle; reverse the arc back.
time_efficient_variation: Slow eccentric only sets — half the volume, same stimulus.
home_variation: Band pec fly anchored to door.
common_compensations: ["elbow bend changing through ROM", "shoulders rolling forward"]

name: Assault Bike
description: Assault bike / air bike — fan-resistance bike that scales with effort; brutally effective for HIIT and conditioning.
instructions: Sit upright, grip handles. Push and pull arms while pedaling, output scales with effort.
progression: Add interval work or longer duration

name: Back Extension
description: Back extension — hyperextension work on a 45° or 90° pad; isolates lumbar erectors and glutes.
instructions: Anchor feet on the pad, hips against the rest. Lower torso under control, then extend to a neutral spine. Don't hyperextend at the top.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with pulls in an antagonist superset.
home_variation: DB RDL or banded RDL at home.

name: Back Extension (Machine)
description: Seated back extension machine — loaded lumbar extension; useful for isolating the erectors when the GHD isn't an option.
instructions: Set the seat so the pad sits on the upper back. Press back into a slight extension, control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with pulls in an antagonist superset.
home_variation: DB RDL or banded RDL at home.

name: Ball Slams
description: Medicine ball / slam-ball slams — full-body conditioning, anti-extension via overhead pull-down power.
instructions: Hold the ball overhead. Slam it down hard between your feet, hinge at the hips and let the ball's bounce die.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Battle Ropes
description: Battle ropes — alternating-wave or double-wave conditioning; full upper body + core.
instructions: Grip the rope ends. In a quarter squat, drive waves alternately or together up and down the rope.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Bench Dip
description: Bench dip — beginner dip variant; less shoulder demand than parallel bar dip.
instructions: Sit on the edge of a bench, hands beside hips. Walk feet out, lower body until elbows reach ~90°, press back up.
progression: Weighted dips with a weight belt
time_efficient_variation: Run dips as a finisher on push days.

name: Bench Press (Cable)
description: Cable bench press — constant tension throughout the press, easier on shoulders than barbell.
instructions: Set cables to chest height with handles. Lie on a flat bench between the stacks, palms facing forward. Press the handles up and slightly together until arms extend. Lower under control until handles are level with chest. Maintain tight scapular retraction.
progression: Pause bench press at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Drop sets on the last set for compressed volume.

name: Bench Press (Smith Machine)
description: Smith machine bench press — fixed bar path; useful for novices learning the press groove or training to failure safely.
instructions: Position a flat bench under the Smith bar so the bar lands mid-chest. Unrack with a slight wrist twist. Lower to the chest, pause briefly, drive back to lockout. Re-rack between sets.
progression: Pause bench press at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Drop sets on the last set for compressed volume.

name: Bench Press - Wide Grip (Barbell)
description: Wide-grip barbell bench — emphasizes chest over triceps via a shorter range and external rotation bias.
instructions: Grip the bar 1.5x shoulder-width or wider. Unrack, lower under control to the lower chest, drive up and slightly back. Keep shoulder blades pinned to the bench.
progression: Pause bench press at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Drop sets on the last set for compressed volume.

name: Bent Over One Arm Row (Dumbbell)
description: Single-arm bent-over row — emphasizes mid-back unilaterally; useful for addressing left/right imbalances.
instructions: Hinge at the hips with a flat back, one hand braced on a bench. Hold the dumbbell with a neutral grip. Row to the lower ribs, leading with the elbow. Pause briefly at the top.
regression: Inverted row at higher bar height
time_efficient_variation: Superset with bench press for upper-body balance.
home_variation: Inverted row at home with a sturdy bar.
common_compensations: ["rounding lower back", "shrugging instead of rowing", "torso rising mid-rep"]

name: Bent Over Row - Underhand (Barbell)
description: Underhand-grip barbell row (Yates row) — more biceps and lower-lat involvement than overhand row, less stress on shoulders.
instructions: Grip the bar shoulder-width, palms up. Hinge to ~45°, keep a flat back. Row to the lower abs, driving elbows back behind the torso.
regression: Inverted row at higher bar height
time_efficient_variation: Superset with bench press for upper-body balance.
home_variation: Inverted row at home with a sturdy bar.
common_compensations: ["rounding lower back", "shrugging instead of rowing", "torso rising mid-rep"]

name: Bicep Curl (Machine)
description: Machine curl — fixed strength curve, easier to push to failure safely; good finisher.
instructions: Adjust seat so upper arms rest flat on the pad. Grip handles, curl up until forearms are vertical, lower under control.
progression: Add a pause at the top
time_efficient_variation: Mechanical drop set: BB curl → reverse curl.
home_variation: DB curl or band curl at home.

name: Cable Row (Single Arm)
description: Single-arm cable row — unilateral horizontal pull; allows rotation through the trunk for slightly more lat activation.
instructions: Stand or kneel facing a low cable. Grip the handle, retract the shoulder, then row to the rib cage with elbow tracking back.
progression: Increase weight or add a pause
time_efficient_variation: Use as a finisher with high-rep volume.
home_variation: Band row anchored at hip height.

name: Cable Twist
description: Cable rotation (high-to-low or horizontal) — strong oblique work with continuous tension; foundation for rotational athletes.
instructions: Set cable at chest height. Stand sideways, arms extended. Rotate through the hips and core away from the stack, return slowly.
time_efficient_variation: Quick warm-up before any rotational sport.

name: Calf Press on Leg Press
description: Calf press on the leg-press machine — heavy loadable calf work without spinal compression.
instructions: Position balls of feet on the lower edge of the press platform. Press up through the toes to full plantarflexion, lower under control.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM 1-minute sets for grease-the-groove calf work.
home_variation: Step or stair raises at home.

name: Calf Press on Seated Leg Press
description: Seated leg-press calf press — same movement as standard leg-press calf raise but on the seated variant.
instructions: Balls of feet at lower edge of plate. Press through the toes, return slowly to a stretch.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM 1-minute sets for grease-the-groove calf work.
home_variation: Step or stair raises at home.

name: Chest Dip
description: Chest dip — leaning forward biases the pectorals; a top-tier chest builder without a bench.
instructions: Mount the bars with arms straight. Lean torso forward ~30°, knees bent. Lower until upper arms are parallel to the floor, drive back to lockout.
progression: Weighted dips with a weight belt
time_efficient_variation: Run dips as a finisher on push days.

name: Chest Dip (Assisted)
description: Band-assisted chest dip — band supports body weight, letting beginners build pressing strength through full range.
instructions: Loop a band across the dip handles and place a knee on it. Lean forward and lower under control, drive back to lockout.
progression: Weighted dips with a weight belt
time_efficient_variation: Run dips as a finisher on push days.

name: Chest Fly
description: Pec-deck or machine chest fly — isolated horizontal adduction with safe shoulder mechanics.
instructions: Sit on the machine with handles at chest height. Bring handles together in front of the chest in an arc, pause and squeeze, return slowly.
time_efficient_variation: Slow eccentric only sets — half the volume, same stimulus.
home_variation: Band pec fly anchored to door.
common_compensations: ["elbow bend changing through ROM", "shoulders rolling forward"]

name: Chest Fly (Band)
description: Band chest fly — accommodating-resistance pec fly; great travel option.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height. Hold both ends, step forward to tension. Bring hands together in an arc, return under control.
time_efficient_variation: Slow eccentric only sets — half the volume, same stimulus.
home_variation: Band pec fly anchored to door.
common_compensations: ["elbow bend changing through ROM", "shoulders rolling forward"]

name: Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell chest fly — supine pec isolation with arc-of-motion adduction; deep stretch + squeeze.
instructions: Lie on a flat bench, DBs above chest with slight elbow bend. Lower out wide in an arc until DBs are at chest level, return to top.
time_efficient_variation: Slow eccentric only sets — half the volume, same stimulus.
home_variation: Band pec fly anchored to door.
common_compensations: ["elbow bend changing through ROM", "shoulders rolling forward"]

name: Chest Press (Band)
description: Band chest press — travel-friendly horizontal push with accommodating resistance.
instructions: Anchor a band behind you at chest height. Grip both ends, step forward to load. Press handles forward to extension, return under control.

name: Chest Press (Machine)
description: Machine chest press — fixed plane chest press; easy to push to failure safely.
instructions: Set the seat so handles align with mid-chest. Press handles forward to extension, lower under control.

name: Clean (Barbell)
description: Barbell clean — full lift from floor to racked position via a front squat catch; foundational Olympic lift.
instructions: Start with the bar over mid-foot, shoulders over the bar. Extend hips and knees explosively, shrug, pull yourself under into a front squat. Stand up.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Clean and Jerk (Barbell)
description: Barbell clean and jerk — clean to front rack, then jerk overhead. The full competition Olympic lift.
instructions: Clean the bar to the front rack. Dip and drive the bar overhead, splitting feet (split jerk) or driving straight up (push jerk). Recover to standing with bar locked out.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Cross Body Crunch
description: Cross-body crunch — couples a rectus crunch with rotation; effective oblique work with no equipment.
instructions: Lie supine, knees bent. Bring opposite elbow to opposite knee, crunching diagonally. Alternate sides each rep.
time_efficient_variation: Run as part of a core circuit.

name: Cuban Press
description: Cuban press — upright row into external rotation into overhead press; rotator-cuff prehab + posterior delt work.
instructions: Hold light DBs at hip. Pull elbows up (upright row) to shoulder height, then rotate forearms up to ear height, then press overhead. Reverse the sequence.
time_efficient_variation: Strict press + push press as a complex.

name: Deadlift High Pull (Barbell)
description: Barbell deadlift high pull — explosive deadlift transitioning into an upright row; conditioning + posterior chain power.
instructions: Conventional deadlift setup. Stand up explosively, then continue the pull upward with high elbows to chin level. Lower under control.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Decline Bench Press (Barbell)
description: Decline barbell bench — emphasizes lower pec fibers; shorter range than flat bench.
instructions: Anchor feet on the decline bench pads. Unrack, lower to lower chest, drive up to lockout. Spotter recommended.
progression: Add a pause at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Pair with incline work as an antagonist superset.
home_variation: Decline push-ups with feet on a couch.

name: Decline Bench Press (Dumbbell)
description: Decline dumbbell bench — same lower-pec bias as barbell version but with independent arm work and deeper stretch.
instructions: Set bench to decline. Anchor feet, sit back with DBs. Press up to lockout, lower until DBs are at lower-chest level.
progression: Add a pause at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Pair with incline work as an antagonist superset.
home_variation: Decline push-ups with feet on a couch.

name: Decline Bench Press (Smith Machine)
description: Decline Smith Machine press — fixed bar path, useful for solo training to failure.
instructions: Set a decline bench in the Smith rack so the bar lands at the lower chest. Press to lockout, lower under control.
progression: Add a pause at the chest
time_efficient_variation: Pair with incline work as an antagonist superset.
home_variation: Decline push-ups with feet on a couch.

name: Decline Crunch
description: Decline crunch — increases ROM and load on rectus by adding bodyweight against gravity.
instructions: Set bench to decline, anchor feet. Lie back, hands at temples. Crunch up by curling shoulders toward hips, lower with control.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Drag Curl
description: Drag curl — pull the bar straight up along the torso by sliding elbows back; minimizes front-delt involvement.
instructions: Stand with a shoulder-width grip on the bar. Curl up by sliding elbows back, dragging the bar along your torso. Reverse the motion under control.
progression: Add a pause at the top
time_efficient_variation: Mechanical drop set: BB curl → reverse curl.
home_variation: DB curl or band curl at home.

name: Dragon Flag
description: Dragon flag — full-body lever core hold popularized by Bruce Lee. Elite-level anterior core strength.
instructions: Lie on a bench, grip an anchor behind your head. Brace hard, then lift legs and lower body together until vertical. Lower to horizontal as slowly as possible without letting hips sag.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Elliptical Machine
description: Elliptical — low-impact cross-training cardio with synced upper and lower body work.
instructions: Adjust resistance and incline. Push with the legs while pulling with the arms. Maintain steady cadence.
progression: Add interval work or longer duration

name: External Rotation
description: Banded external rotation — rotator-cuff prehab; one of the most prescribed shoulder-health exercises.
instructions: Anchor a light band at elbow height. Grip with the far hand, elbow pinned at 90° to your side. Rotate the forearm outward away from your body, control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Strict press + push press as a complex.

name: Flat Knee Raise
description: Lying knee raise — supine hip flexion + lower abdominal work; foundational core movement.
instructions: Lie supine, hands at sides for support. Bring knees toward chest by rolling hips up, lower with control.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with grip work for a compact finisher.

name: Flat Leg Raise
description: Lying leg raise — supine straight-leg variant; loads hip flexors and rectus abdominis through a longer lever.
instructions: Lie supine. Raise straight legs to vertical, then lower without touching the floor. Press low back into the floor throughout.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with grip work for a compact finisher.

name: Glute Bridge
description: Glute bridge — supine hip extension; foundational glute activation pattern.
instructions: Lie supine, knees bent, feet flat. Drive heels into the floor to lift hips up. Squeeze glutes at the top, lower under control.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with pulls in an antagonist superset.
home_variation: DB RDL or banded RDL at home.

name: Glute Kickback (Machine)
description: Glute kickback machine — single-leg hip extension with consistent loading; isolates glute max.
instructions: Position foot pad behind one leg. Extend the leg back by driving the heel, squeeze glutes at end-range.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with pulls in an antagonist superset.
home_variation: DB RDL or banded RDL at home.

name: Handstand Push Up
description: Handstand push-up — bodyweight vertical press, premier shoulder strength + skill demonstration.
instructions: Kick up to a handstand against a wall. Lower until head taps the floor, press back to lockout.
time_efficient_variation: Strict press + push press as a complex.

name: Hang Snatch (Barbell)
description: Hang snatch — Olympic snatch initiated from above the knee. Skips the floor pull; teaches the second pull and turnover.
instructions: Start with the bar at hang (above knee), snatch grip. Triple-extend explosively, shrug, pull yourself under into an overhead squat or power-snatch catch.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: High Knee Skips
description: High knee skips — running drill combining a skip with explosive knee drive; foundational for sprint mechanics.
instructions: Skip forward, driving one knee up toward chest height with each cycle. Stay tall, arms swing opposite to legs.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Hip Adductor (Machine)
description: Hip adductor machine — isolates the inner thigh; useful for groin health and balanced hip strength.
instructions: Sit in the machine, pads on inside of knees. Squeeze legs together, control the opening.
time_efficient_variation: Top-set + 2 backoff sets is enough stimulus.
home_variation: Goblet squat or bodyweight squat at home.

name: Incline Chest Fly (Dumbbell)
description: Incline DB fly — emphasizes the upper pec fibers through arc-of-motion adduction.
instructions: Set bench to 30-45°. Hold DBs above chest with slight elbow bend. Lower out wide in an arc, return to top.
time_efficient_variation: Slow eccentric only sets — half the volume, same stimulus.
home_variation: Band pec fly anchored to door.
common_compensations: ["elbow bend changing through ROM", "shoulders rolling forward"]

name: Incline Chest Press (Machine)
description: Incline machine chest press — upper-chest emphasis with fixed plane; good failure work.
instructions: Adjust seat so handles align with upper chest. Press to extension, lower under control.

name: Incline Row (Dumbbell)
description: Incline chest-supported DB row — supported variant removes lower-back demand, isolates the back.
instructions: Set bench to ~30°. Lie chest-down. Row DBs with elbows tracking past torso, squeeze mid-back.
regression: Inverted row at higher bar height
time_efficient_variation: Superset with bench press for upper-body balance.
home_variation: Inverted row at home with a sturdy bar.
common_compensations: ["rounding lower back", "shrugging instead of rowing", "torso rising mid-rep"]

name: Iso-Lateral Chest Press (Machine)
description: Iso-lateral (plate-loaded) chest press — independent arm levers; useful for unilateral loading and addressing imbalances.
instructions: Set seat so handles align with mid-chest. Press each side independently or together. Lower under control.
progression: Add a pause or slower eccentric
time_efficient_variation: Drop sets are easy and effective on these machines.

name: Iso-Lateral Row (Machine)
description: Iso-lateral (plate-loaded) row — chest-supported single-arm row; great for direct lat work with no spinal load.
instructions: Chest pressed into the pad. Row each handle to the rib cage, leading with the elbow. Squeeze at end-range.
progression: Add a pause or slower eccentric
time_efficient_variation: Drop sets are easy and effective on these machines.

name: Jackknife Sit Up
description: V-up / jackknife — simultaneous reach of arms and legs to meet over the body; demanding flexion movement.
instructions: Lie supine, arms overhead. In one motion, raise legs and torso to meet, reaching hands toward feet. Reverse with control.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Jump Rope
description: Jump rope — calf endurance, coordination, low-load conditioning. Foundational athletic skill.
instructions: Hold rope handles, wrists relaxed. Jump just high enough to clear the rope, landing softly on the balls of the feet.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Jump Shrug (Barbell)
description: Barbell jump shrug — Olympic accessory teaching triple extension; bar stays low, focus is on aggressive hip drive.
instructions: Deadlift setup, snatch- or clean-width grip. Extend hips and knees explosively, finishing on the balls of the feet with a hard shrug. Bar travels minimally upward.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Jump Squat
description: Bodyweight jump squat — plyometric squat for lower-body power; descend into a squat, explode vertically.
instructions: Stand feet shoulder-width. Squat to a quarter or half depth, then jump explosively. Land softly, immediately reset for the next rep.
time_efficient_variation: Top-set + 2 backoff sets is enough stimulus.
home_variation: Goblet squat or bodyweight squat at home.

name: Jumping Jack
description: Jumping jacks — full-body warm-up and conditioning; raises heart rate and warms the shoulders.
instructions: Stand tall. Simultaneously jump feet out wide while raising arms overhead, then return. Maintain rhythm.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Kettlebell Clean
description: Kettlebell single-arm clean — KB swing variation that finishes in a front-rack position; foundational KB skill.
instructions: Start with KB between feet. Hike-pass back, then drive the hips through. As KB rises, guide the elbow back and let the KB land softly in the rack position. Reverse to the floor.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Kipping Pull Up
description: Kipping pull-up — uses a coordinated hip drive to perform faster, higher-volume reps. CrossFit staple, not a strict strength exercise.
instructions: Hang from the bar with shoulders engaged. Swing into hollow → arch position. Use hip drive to pop the chin over the bar.
time_efficient_variation: Daily greasing-the-groove sets at home or office.
common_compensations: ["partial ROM", "kipping for non-kip reps", "shoulder shrug instead of pull"]

name: Knee Raise (Captain's Chair)
description: Captain's chair knee raise — forearm-supported variant; easier on the grip than hanging versions.
instructions: Position forearms on the pads. Bring knees to chest by curling the pelvis up, lower under control.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with grip work for a compact finisher.
cues: curl pelvis up, not hip flex

name: Kneeling Pulldown (Band)
description: Kneeling band pulldown — vertical pull pattern from a band anchored overhead; portable lat work.
instructions: Anchor a band overhead. Kneel, grip with both hands. Pull elbows down and back, return slowly.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Knees to Elbows
description: Knees-to-elbows — hanging knee raise variant where the knees touch the elbows; CrossFit gymnastic skill.
instructions: Hang. Drive knees up and forward to touch the elbows. Control the descent without swinging.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with grip work for a compact finisher.

name: L-Sit
description: L-Sit — gymnastic core hold with legs out parallel to floor while supported on hands. Brutal compression strength.
instructions: Press up on parallettes (or floor) with arms straight. Lift legs to horizontal, hold without letting hips drop.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Landmine RDL
description: Landmine RDL — hip hinge with one end of the bar anchored; smoother path than a barbell RDL.
instructions: Anchor one end of the bar in a landmine. Stand at the free end, hold the bar in both hands. Hinge to a stretch, drive hips through to stand.
time_efficient_variation: Pair with pulls in an antagonist superset.
home_variation: DB RDL or banded RDL at home.

name: Landmine Row
description: Landmine T-bar row — landmine-anchored barbell rowed bent-over; strong horizontal pull with reduced spinal load.
instructions: Anchor one end of the bar. Straddle the free end, hinge to ~45°. Grip the bar (V-handle or hands). Row to the sternum.
regression: Inverted row at higher bar height
time_efficient_variation: Superset with bench press for upper-body balance.
home_variation: Inverted row at home with a sturdy bar.
common_compensations: ["rounding lower back", "shrugging instead of rowing", "torso rising mid-rep"]

name: Landmine Squat
description: Landmine squat — bar held at chest with one end anchored; provides a stable arc, useful for novices and rehab.
instructions: Hold the free end of the bar at the chest. Squat to depth, drive up. The bar follows a slight arc; allow this naturally.
time_efficient_variation: Top-set + 2 backoff sets is enough stimulus.
home_variation: Goblet squat or bodyweight squat at home.

name: Lat Pulldown (Cable)
description: Cable lat pulldown — vertical pulling staple; scaled by stack weight.
instructions: Grip bar wider than shoulder-width. Pull bar to upper chest by driving elbows down and back. Control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Lat Pulldown (Machine)
description: Machine lat pulldown (selectorized) — same movement as cable but with a fixed-frame machine.
instructions: Set thigh pads. Grip the bar, pull to upper chest, control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Lat Pulldown (Single Arm)
description: Single-arm cable lat pulldown — unilateral pulling, lets the lat fully shorten without contralateral interference.
instructions: Stand or kneel. Grip a single handle, pull elbow down and back to the ribs. Switch sides each set.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Lat Pulldown - Underhand (Band)
description: Band underhand pulldown — supinated grip biases lower lats and biceps; portable lat work.
instructions: Anchor band overhead. Kneel, grip palms-up, pull to chest. Control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Lat Pulldown - Underhand (Cable)
description: Underhand cable pulldown — supinated grip emphasizes lower lats + biceps.
instructions: Grip bar palms-up, shoulder-width. Pull to upper chest with elbows tucked. Control the return.
time_efficient_variation: Strict tempo (3-sec eccentric) reduces volume need.
common_compensations: ["body lean for momentum", "bar to forehead instead of chest"]

name: Lunge (Barbell)
description: Barbell forward lunge — loaded unilateral squat pattern; great single-leg builder.
instructions: Bar on traps. Step forward with one leg, lower until back knee almost touches floor. Drive through front heel to stand.
time_efficient_variation: Run walking lunges as a leg-day finisher.
home_variation: Bodyweight or DB lunges at home.

name: Lunge (Bodyweight)
description: Bodyweight forward lunge — accessible single-leg pattern; foundational movement quality work.
instructions: Step forward, lower until back knee nears floor. Stand back to start. Alternate or work one side at a time.
time_efficient_variation: Run walking lunges as a leg-day finisher.
home_variation: Bodyweight or DB lunges at home.

name: Lunge (Dumbbell)
description: Dumbbell forward lunge — loaded lunge with goblet or hands-at-side carry.
instructions: Hold DBs at sides. Step forward, lower under control until back knee approaches floor. Drive through front heel to stand.
time_efficient_variation: Run walking lunges as a leg-day finisher.
home_variation: Bodyweight or DB lunges at home.

name: Mountain Climber
description: Mountain climber — dynamic plank with alternating knee drive; core endurance + conditioning.
instructions: Start in a push-up position. Drive one knee toward the chest, switch quickly to the other. Keep hips low and steady.
time_efficient_variation: EMOM or AMRAP formats compress volume.

name: Muscle Up
description: Muscle-up — explosive pull-up + transition to a dip; iconic bodyweight skill combining pulling and pressing strength.
instructions: Hang from the bar or rings. Pull explosively, transition the chest over the bar, then press out to lockout. Reverse with control.
time_efficient_variation: Daily greasing-the-groove sets at home or office.
common_compensations: ["partial ROM", "kipping for non-kip reps", "shoulder shrug instead of pull"]

name: Oblique Crunch
description: Oblique crunch — side-lying or rotational crunch targeting the obliques.
instructions: Lie supine with knees bent and dropped to one side. Crunch up while keeping legs to the side. Switch sides each set.
time_efficient_variation: Run as part of a core circuit.

name: Overhead Squat (Barbell)
description: Overhead squat — squat with the bar locked out overhead. Demanding mobility + stability test; Olympic accessory.
instructions: Hold a snatch-grip bar locked out overhead. Squat to depth keeping the bar over the heels. Stand up.
time_efficient_variation: Top-set + 2 backoff sets is enough stimulus.
home_variation: Goblet squat or bodyweight squat at home.

name: Pistol Squat
description: Pistol squat — full single-leg squat to depth with the other leg extended forward. Premier bodyweight leg builder.
instructions: Stand on one leg, arms forward for balance. Lower into a deep squat, free leg extending forward. Stand back up without the foot touching down.
time_efficient_variation: Cycle through unilateral patterns for a fast finisher.
home_variation: Pistol or split squat at home.

name: Plank
description: Forearm plank — anti-extension isometric; foundational core stability hold.
instructions: Get on forearms and toes, body in a straight line head to heel. Brace abs, squeeze glutes. Hold without letting hips sag or hike.
progression: Add weight or extend the lever

name: Plyo Push-Up
description: Plyometric push-up — explosive push-up with hands leaving the floor; upper-body power development.
instructions: From push-up position, lower under control, then drive up explosively so hands leave the floor. Land softly into the next rep.
progression: Weighted dips with a weight belt
time_efficient_variation: Run dips as a finisher on push days.
cues: land in a soft elbow bend

name: Press Under (Barbell)
description: Barbell press under (drop snatch) — Olympic teaching drill for the turnover. Trains the active receiving position in the snatch.
instructions: Bar in a back- or front-rack position with snatch grip. Dip slightly, then drop into an overhead squat catching the bar at lockout.
progression: Increase load, work from the floor
home_variation: Kettlebell or DB versions at home.
common_compensations: ["bar drifting away from body", "early arm bend"]

name: Push Up (Knees)
description: Knee push-up — regression for the standard push-up; bears ~50% of body weight.
instructions: Plank position from the knees, hands shoulder-width. Lower chest to within a fist's distance of the floor, press up.
progression: Weighted dips with a weight belt
time_efficient_variation: Run dips as a finisher on push days.

name: Rack Pull (Barbell)
description: Rack pull — partial deadlift from blocks or pins, usually starting at the knees. Heavy lockout work + traps.
instructions: Set pins at the knee. Grip the bar, brace, pull from pins to lockout. Lower under control.
time_efficient_variation: Top-set + 3 backoff sets keeps it under 30 min.
home_variation: Trap-bar or DB deadlift at home.
common_compensations: ["rounded lower back", "bar drifting from body", "hips rising too fast"]

name: Reverse Curl (Band)
description: Band reverse curl — overhand grip emphasizes brachioradialis + forearm extensors; band provides accommodating resistance.
instructions: Stand on the band, grip with palms down at hip width. Curl up to shoulder height keeping elbows pinned. Lower with control.
progression: Switch to fat-grip or thick-bar reverse curl
time_efficient_variation: Pair with bicep curls for forearm + bicep finisher.

name: Reverse Curl (Barbell)
description: Barbell reverse curl — overhand grip biases brachioradialis and forearm extensors; underrated for grip strength.
instructions: Grip the bar shoulder-width with palms down. Curl up to shoulder level keeping elbows pinned. Pause, lower under control.
progression: Switch to fat-grip or thick-bar reverse curl
time_efficient_variation: Pair with bicep curls for forearm + bicep finisher.

name: Reverse Curl (Dumbbell)
